scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ml,web -c cyan,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:ml" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.preview:prod: pnpm build && concurrently -k -n api,ml -c cyan,magenta "cd api && APP_URL=http://localhost:8000 node --env-file-if-exists=../.env src/index.ts" "uv run --directory ml uvicorn app.service:app --port 8001"
scripts.test: uv run --directory ml pytest -q && pnpm --filter coinvoy-api test && pnpm --filter coinvoy-frontend test
scripts.lint: uv run --directory ml ruff check . && pnpm --filter coinvoy-api lint && pnpm --filter coinvoy-frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter coinvoy-api typecheck && pnpm --filter coinvoy-frontend typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.train:bm: uv run --directory ml python scripts/make_bm_seed.py && uv run --directory ml python scripts/train_bm_classifier.py
